svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Topology of the fabric: two sites and the inter-site network
svg.desc: Two sites joined by an inter-site network. DC-1, AS 65001: spine-11 and spine-12, each linked to leaf-101, leaf-102, leaf-103, leaf-104 and two border leafs; leaf-101 and leaf-102 are a vPC pair with a dual-homed host; the border leafs peer with an external router by eBGP, one session per tenant. DC-2, AS 65002: spine-21 and spine-22, each linked to leaf-201 and leaf-202. The spines of both sites are Multi-Site border gateways. The inter-site network, AS 65000: isn-1 peers by eBGP with DC-1's spines, isn-2 with DC-2's, and the two with each other. The border gateways of the two sites peer by eBGP EVPN across it.
svg.text: Spines: PIM rendezvous point, EVPN route reflectors (RR), Multi-Site border gateways (BGW)
Leafs: VTEPs with the anycast gateway
Border leafs: the tenants' L3VNIs, and the way out for both sites
Inter-site network: two routers that carry the sites' loopbacks in BGP, nothing else
eBGP EVPN between the border gateways of the two sites, across the inter-site network
